name: Marco
source:
"When you arrive on a new planet, first stop is food."

Along with the galaxy dragon Arco, they live a life of travelling around the galaxy selling treasure they stole. But now, in search of the one treasure she's never seen, her mother... She and Arco left on an adventure.
She's always hungry.
